treatment_difference.construction: charged fallible anchored-provenance maintenance only when exact source results are mechanically externalized
treatment_difference.verification: semantic scaffold replaced by a compact external-custody receipt; exact artifact and current verification frame remain

continuation_rule: No automatic continuation. Literal actor and maintenance transcripts, demand, candidate changes, effects, and recurrence are reviewed at each checkpoint. A policy change creates a new experiment.
primary_outcomes: correct readiness or explicit incomplete stop
claim_limits: The first tranche is exploratory and cannot promote an architecture.
A treatment difference supports the whole configuration, not the scaffold in isolation.
A checkpoint pause is not useful completion.
Fewer tokens or earlier submission is not a win unless candidate-bound quality and readiness support it.
